grading.drop: Best 24 of 26 check-ins count; best 12 of 14 in-class activities count (the two lowest are dropped).

FACS 2000.finalExam: No exam; the final project is due Oct 3 by 12:30 PM and requires presence for the whole class period for the group presentation.
FACS 2000.attendance: Attendance is not taken, but in-class activity points require being present for the whole activity; the Sept 24 group work day is mandatory and cannot be a dropped day.
FACS 2000.lateWork: Week 1 activities lose 20% of their points per day when late.
FACS 2000.makeups: In-class activities cannot be made up, except when previously documented UGA-related activities cause more than two missed days (the first two missed days are the drops).
other: Earning TopHat credit without being present, or helping someone else do so, is academic dishonesty.
Disputes about activity grades or absences must go to the TA within one week of the grade posting.
